create_fl_batch_metrics: create an FLBatchMetrics instance with loss, num_examples, predictions, targets, and model_inputs tensors
get_batch_loss: get the loss tensor from an FLBatchMetrics instance via the loss property
get_batch_num_examples: get the number of examples from an FLBatchMetrics instance via the num_examples property
get_batch_predictions: get the predictions tensor from an FLBatchMetrics instance via the predictions property
get_batch_targets: get the targets tensor from an FLBatchMetrics instance via the targets property
